resources.string: Native GameCube port · bring your own game data
Animal Crossing USA (GAFE01) as .iso, .gcm, .ciso or NKit.
Animal Crossing HD Texture Pack by TechieAndroid, Brackenhawk and the AC modding community. Downloaded from its original source and converted on this device (one time, a few minutes, ~1.5 GB).
Downloads about 146 MB from Google Drive (link from the pack\'s Dolphin forum thread) and converts the textures for this device. Continue?
Translations are generated from your European disc (GAFP01); no game text ships with the app.
%s is not set up yet – create it from your European disc.
Gamepad, keyboard or touch overlay (hides while a controller is used). Select/Back opens the pause menu.
This is not the USA disc (GAFE01): %s
Delete the converted HD textures? Reinstalling takes a few minutes.
Town %1$s is in memory card B

Visit a friend\'s town like with a second memory card: share your town as a code, your friend takes the train to it and sends it back. Needs a server that one of you hosts (see tools/multiplayer-server on GitHub). Save & quit the game before using these buttons.
Address of the exchange server (tools/multiplayer-server), e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8765 at home or a Tailscale/tunnel address. Leave empty to turn off.
Server key (if the host set one)
Your town is already shared. Withdraw it to share it again?
Uploads your saved town. Your friend visits it and sends it back; when you fetch it back it replaces your town (a backup is kept). Don\'t play your own town in the meantime, or that progress is lost.
Give this code to your friend. It stays valid for a few days.
%1$s is now in memory card B. In the game, go to the train station, talk to the station attendant and travel to the other town. Come back home by train, save, then press \"Send town back\".
Only send the town back after you returned home by train and saved. It goes back to its owner and memory card B is emptied (a backup is kept).
Town sent back to its owner.
Your friend has not sent your town back yet.
Your town came back. It will replace your current save (a backup is kept in save-backups). Continue?
Your town is back. Have fun!
No town save found yet. Play and save once first.
There is no visited town in memory card B.
You have not shared your town.

Cuyler36\'s Deluxe mod (e+ villagers and decorations, ordinances, storage and much more). It replaces the game code, so it runs in the Dolphin emulator, not in this port. The patch is downloaded from the official site and applied to your own disc image (US ISO/NKit or PAL/AUS ISO).
Choose your clean, unmodified disc image (US ISO or NKit, PAL or Australian ISO). The latest Deluxe patch is downloaded from cuyler36.github.io and the result is saved to Download/ACDX.
Saved as %1$s.\n\nIn Dolphin, add the folder Download/ACDX once (Settings, Paths, add folder). Then \"Play in Dolphin\" starts Deluxe directly.
This disc image is not a supported clean source for Deluxe. Use an unmodified US ISO/NKit or PAL/Australian ISO (for example a CleanRip dump).
In Dolphin, tap \"Add Games\" (or Settings, Paths) once and choose the folder Download/ACDX. Afterwards this button starts Deluxe directly.
